---
name: Code Review
description: Review a diff or larger code area for regressions, missing tests, API drift, stale code, redundancy, and architecture or safety violations.

Canonical definition: `.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md`

Use for:
- pre-commit or pre-merge review

- deep code review of a subsystem

Prefer the canonical `SKILL.md` for the full workflow, review modes, and output shape.
